When requested by this DID, the radio shall report the authorization status of the radio to transmit GPS and Compass information on the vehicle CAN bus.
When requested by this DID, the radio shall change the radio's authorization to transmit GPS and Compass information on the vehicle CAN bus using the provided settings.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall report the Date - Month as provided by the internal GPS receiver.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall report the Date - Day as provided by the internal GPS receiver.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall select to override the country code received via vehicle configuration.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall report if the country code received via vehicle configuration is being overridden.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall report the current brand splash screen that is displayed at system startup.
When requested via this DID, the radio shall change the brand splash screen that is displayed at system startup.
The "Automatic" setting shall indicate that the radio is using the vehicle config value.
The "Automatic" setting indicates the radio shall use the splash screen determined from the vehicle configuration process. Refer to CFTS009 for brand configuration information.
Settings other than the "Automatic" setting shall override the splash screen determined from the vehicle configuration process.
The market selection configuration shall be readable from and writeable to this DID.

The Anti-Theft Enable Status data shall be readable from and writeable to this DID. The Anti-Theft Enable Status shows the status of the radio's anti-theft setting. The enable state shall only be overridden while the diagnostic tool is present on the bus. A full bus sleep/wake cycle is permitted before the radio again must return to normal anti-theft behavior.
The SCL shall be readable from this DID. The SCL reports the radio's SCL.
The Sales Code shall be readable from this DID. The Sales Code reports the radio's three-character sales code.
The PCL shall be readable from this DID. The PCL reports the radio's PCL.
Byte 4 shall contain the minor version.
Byte 3 shall contain the major version.
When requested by this DID, the radio shall report the internal temperature as measured by an internal thermistor.
When requested by this DID, the radio shall report the Standby status. The Standby status indicates if the radio is in standby mode with either True or False. See {VF169} for power state details.
When requested by this DID, the radio shall report the Key status. The Key status indicates the ignition status as received over the CAN bus. See {VF169} for power state details.
The Actual SW Frequency shall be readable from this DID. The Actual SW Frequency is the current radio tuned SW band frequency.
The Actual MW Frequency shall be readable from this DID. The Actual MW Frequency is the current radio tuned MW or AM band frequency.
The Actual LW Frequency shall be readable from this DID. The Actual LW Frequency is the current radio tuned LW band frequency.
The Actual FM Frequency shall be readable from this DID. The Actual FM Frequency is the current radio tuned FM band frequency.
The Actual DAB Channel shall be readable from this DID. The Actual DAB Channel is the current radio tuned DAB Channel.
The AM/FM tuner signal strength shall be readable from this DID in units of dBuV.
Each DID description shall contain the corresponding tuner identification.
When requested, this DID shall report the currently displayed test pattern.

Unless otherwise specified, all ECUs implementing DTCs shall support data polling periods at a maximum period of 1/10 of the mature or de-mature time (whichever is smaller). This means, for example, that a DTC checking for a voltage level on a specific pin that matures and de-matures after 5 seconds shall check the voltage level at a period of 0.5 seconds.

When commanded to perform this routine, the radio shall enter the IDLE (or Screen Off + Muted if there is no power button) as described in CFTS_009.
When commanded to perform this routine, the radio shall enable the following user interface controls: hard keys, touchscreen controls, Steering Wheel controls, and Voice Recognition commands.
